Page.NoReligion: Religion excluded by the generator settings.

App.Title: LANCER Planet Generator
App.Name: Name
App.NamePlaceholder: Leave blank to roll a name
App.Empty: Press Generate to roll a planet.

Reroll.Title: Re-roll Planet: {name}
Reroll.Hint: Choose which sections to re-roll. The journal page will be rewritten from the new results, replacing any manual edits.
Reroll.LoreHint: Planet Lore is rewritten automatically whenever a section it mentions is re-rolled.

Galaxy.Title: LANCER Galaxy Map
Galaxy.RegenerateConfirm: Generate a new galaxy? The current map will be replaced (saved journal entries are kept).
Galaxy.SelectSector: Click a sector to see and edit its planets. Use the tools above to add, move, link or erase sectors.
Galaxy.Disabled: The galaxy map is disabled in the module settings.
Galaxy.ClearConfirm: Remove every sector and route and start from an empty grid? Saved journal entries are kept.

ToolHints.select: Click a sector to select it. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan.
ToolHints.addRandom: Click an empty hex to add a randomly rolled sector (name, controller and planets fit its position).
ToolHints.addBlank: Click an empty hex to add a blank, unclaimed sector with no planets.
ToolHints.move: Click a sector to pick it up.
ToolHints.movePending: Moving {name}: click an empty hex to place it, or click it again to cancel.
ToolHints.link: Click a sector, then another, to add or remove a blink-gate route between them.
ToolHints.linkPending: Linking from {name}: click another sector to toggle a route, or click it again to cancel.
ToolHints.erase: Click a sector to delete it and its routes.

Galaxy.EraseConfirm: Delete {name}, its planets and its routes? Saved journal entries are kept.
Galaxy.DeletePlanetConfirm: Delete {name} from this sector? A saved journal entry is kept.
Galaxy.LoreHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Re-rolling a section the lore mentions rewrites the lore.
Galaxy.PlanetSavedJournal: Saved {name} to the galaxy map and its journal entry.
Galaxy.SyncHint: Saving also rewrites this planet's journal entry (replacing manual edits made in the journal).
Galaxy.UnsavedHint: Changes are saved to the galaxy map. Use Save to Journal in the sector list to create a journal entry.

FactionWeights.Title: Faction Weighting
FactionWeights.Hint: Enable or disable factions in the controlling-faction pool and scale how often they are rolled (1 = normal, 2 = twice as likely, 0.5 = half). HORUS is never part of the pool.

JournalFolder.Name: Default journal folder
JournalFolder.Hint: Name of the Journal folder new planets are saved into. Created automatically if it doesn't exist. Leave blank to save at the top level.

Compendium.Name: Default compendium
Compendium.Hint: Optional compendium ID (e.g. world.lancer-planets). When set and unlocked, planets are saved there instead of the folder above.

IncludeReligion.Name: Include religion
IncludeReligion.Hint: Roll a religion for each planet. When off, the Religion section is left out.

CoreChance.Name: Core world chance (%)
CoreChance.Hint: Chance that a planet is a Core world when Core status is rolled.

FactionWeights.Name: Faction weighting
FactionWeights.Label: Configure Factions
FactionWeights.Hint: Enable, disable, and weight factions in the controlling-faction pool.

ShowSceneControl.Name: Scene control button
ShowSceneControl.Hint: Add a Planet Generator button to the Journal Notes scene controls.

EnableGalaxyMap.Name: Enable galaxy map (experimental)
EnableGalaxyMap.Hint: Adds a Galaxy Map window with procedurally generated sectors, controlling powers, and blink-gate routes.

Errors.PackNotFound: Compendium {id} not found or not a Journal compendium; saving to the folder instead.
Errors.PackLocked: Compendium {id} is locked; saving to the folder instead.
Errors.NoData: This journal entry has no generator data to re-roll.
